verdict.rationale: There is no documented hosted sandbox or test mode. The GitHub repo does describe a quickstart that starts a matching Lago version and creates a disposable local organization to price illustrative requests, and the docs offer Docker self-hosting. Together these give an isolated local environment for testing away from production data. missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test-mode environment (e.g., separate test API keys or a hosted sandbox org), guidance on isolating test data from production, independent or hands-on corroboration.
